name: worklist
description: To-do sidebar next to the chat: queue tasks, even while Claude is working. When Claude is clearly done, the to-do is checked off and the next one starts; otherwise the list stops with a reason and buttons (Continue keeps the order). Runs by default, never pauses on its own. Survives /clear. History per project. /todo, /todos help

language.title: Language / Sprache
language.description: Language of the mod's texts and of its model prompts. en: English, de: Deutsch.

haiku.title: Haiku 5.5 for unclear cases
haiku.description: When the rules can't tell whether Claude is done, worklist briefly asks Haiku 5.5 (claude-haiku-5-5, effort high; measured at about 0.01 US cents per case). Off: the list stops in those cases instead.

doneLine.title: Hidden hints
doneLine.description: Gives Claude, invisibly, a hint with every sent to-do (end with a clear question, use AskUserQuestion if available, or with "Done."; German: "Fertig.") and with your answer to a stopped to-do's question. It isn't shown in the chat. Makes the detection more reliable.

settleSeconds.title: Settle time (seconds)
settleSeconds.description: How long worklist waits before sending the next to-do, then checks again that Claude is free.

maxAutoRun.title: To-dos in a row
maxAutoRun.description: At most this many to-dos run one after another without your input; then the list stops.
